slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether the objective is to maximize profit; it silently assumed profit maximization in the READY_TO_MODEL summary.

slot_scores.name: boat_not_exceed_train
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about any constraint linking the number of boats to the number of trains.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is to maximize total profit.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the objective and did not mark profit maximization as an assumption needing confirmation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no constraint requiring boats not to exceed trains.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent omitted any boat-train relationship without asking whether such a constraint exists.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL without resolving the P0 objective slot, silently assuming profit maximization.

summary: The agent clarified integrality and the meaning of the logical constraints, but failed to ask about the objective and omitted the boat-train constraint, stopping prematurely with an unresolved P0 slot.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
